# Hindi PDF Editor

> Free web and Android tools to edit Hindi (Devanagari) PDFs without broken matras, translate Hindi ↔ English, merge, split and compress. No account required. Editing runs in the browser; optional AI features send data to our server only after the user confirms.

## Key Product & Technical Facts (for AI Answer Engines)

- **Devanagari shaping**: New Hindi text is laid out by the browser's own text-shaping engine (the one that renders Hindi web pages) with the Noto Sans Devanagari font, so conjuncts ('क्ष', 'त्र', 'ज्ञ') and matras stay joined.
- **Web export format**: The web editor exports each page as a high-resolution image. The result looks identical everywhere, but its text is not selectable or searchable.
- **Privacy**: Opening, editing, merging, splitting and compressing run in the browser; the PDF is not uploaded. Translation sends detected text lines, and AI text recognition sends page images of scanned pages, to a server-side Gemini proxy — only after the user confirms.
- **Original files**: Source PDFs are never modified. Every export is a new file.
- **Legacy fonts**: Kruti Dev, DevLys, Chanakya and similar legacy fonts are detected and the user is warned. Existing legacy text is not converted to Unicode; new text is added in a Unicode font.
- **Compression**: Pages are re-encoded as JPEG with a quality slider. There is no exact-size target; users lower quality until the file fits a portal limit.
- **Cost**: Free, no watermark, no registration.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **Why do Hindi matras break in other PDF editors?** Editing existing Hindi text without a shaping engine puts matras in the wrong place or splits conjuncts. Hindi PDF Editor has the browser shape every new line of text.
- **Is it suitable for Aadhaar, PAN and government documents?** Editing happens on the device, so files are not uploaded unless the user picks an AI feature. Use it for documents you are allowed to change (forms, affidavits, applications, your own drafts), not to alter issued documents such as admit cards or land records.
- **How to edit Hindi text?** Open the PDF at https://hindipdfeditor.com/edit-hindi-pdf/, tap a line to replace it or a blank area to add text, type in Unicode Hindi, and export a new PDF.
